title: 观者自在 (AlreadyThere)：多模型互查程序 / AlreadyThere: a multi-model cross-verification program
description:
多个不同厂商的大模型分工合作：生产者各自独立作答，审查者不做题、只核对比对并独立验证，找茬者专门找各方可能共同漏掉的地方；凡程序能核对的一律由程序核对；只有各方真的一致才算闭合，不按多数；全过程写入哈希链账本。2.x 增加了数学最终答案题；1.x 起的资料整理仍可使用。测试结果及其前提条件见 README 与“测试记录”；尚未实现的内容见“待实现”。

Several LLMs from different vendors work together, each with its own role: producers answer independently; reviewers do not solve the problem but check and compare every answer sheet and verify independently; a fault-finder looks specifically for blind spots that all parties may share. Everything the program can check, it checks itself; a question is closed only when all parties genuinely agree, never by majority vote; the whole process is recorded in a hash-chained ledger. Version 2.x adds math problems with a final answer; fact compilation, available since 1.x, can still be used. See the README and 测试记录/ (test records, in Chinese) for the results and the conditions under which they were obtained, and 待实现.md (to-do list, in Chinese) for what is not yet implemented.

AI 协作声明：设计思想是在作者与 DeepSeek、豆包、Claude、ChatGPT 的对话中形成的；程序代码由 Claude（Anthropic）编写；在实跑中担任程序角色的模型：1.x 为 DeepSeek、Kimi、豆包，2.x 为 Kimi、DeepSeek、腾讯混元、千问、智谱 GLM、豆包。模型不列为作者。

AI collaboration: design ideas took shape in the author's conversations with DeepSeek, Doubao, Claude and ChatGPT; code written by Claude (Anthropic); models that filled the program's roles in real runs: DeepSeek, Kimi, Doubao (1.x); Kimi, DeepSeek, Tencent Hunyuan, Qwen, Zhipu GLM, Doubao (2.x). Models are not listed as authors.
